##### Project general facts

Sunset Grove Homes is a prestigious residential development, epitomising prestige through its meticulously crafted villas. Reflecting the fervent passion and unwavering commitment of its creators, this exclusive community features a collection of elegant homes where every day ends in a tapestry of tranquility. With an opulent design that seamlessly merges with modern convenience, Sunset Grove Homes offers an unparalleled living experience enhanced by vibrant outdoor spaces and unique amenities.

Each villa at Sunset Grove Homes offers unparalleled comfort, elegance, and privacy. The ground floor features a spacious lounge radiating elegance and tranquility, a dining space offering a delightful setting for tasteful culinary experiences, and a modern kitchen with sleek appliances. A tranquil ground floor bedroom with an attached bathroom offers a spa-like retreat. The first floor features two bedrooms with a study area and bathrooms, while the second floor boasts a master suite with a walking closet, a utility room, a terrace, and a private jacuzzi.

Every residence at Sunset Grove Homes features modern interiors with a subtle colour scheme and abundant natural light. The kitchens are designed with sleek appliances and ample counter space, creating a culinary haven. Bedrooms are transformed into tranquil retreat havens with soft hues and large wall windows, while bathrooms characterise contemporary elegance with sleek fixtures and top-of-the-line fittings. The master suite extends its comfort zone with a spacious walking closet providing ample storage for clothing and accessories.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, this exceptional location offers excellent connectivity to various colleges, schools, and landmarks. With multiple educational institutions within a short radius, residents enjoy easy access to quality education. The community is home to over two thousand residential units, featuring a village-like setting with parks and canals surrounding apartments, villas, and townhouses.

The location is distinguished by its status as a one-stop destination with the city's best offerings in retail and dining. Dubai's key landmarks including Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Mall of Emirates, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport are all within easy reach. The community's thoughtful planning ensures residents enjoy the perfect balance of peaceful living and urban convenience.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, tranquility, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience opulent amenities and personalized service in a slice of paradise.
